summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (2.88% of S/O), ¥280.0M upper limit, ¥233/share implied ceiling, ToSTNeT-3 market purchase, Aug 26 - Dec 24, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: jig.jp resolved on 25 August 2026 to acquire up to 1,200,000 treasury shares (2.88% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥280.0 million, implying a price ceiling of approximately ¥233 per share. The acquisition will be conducted via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 26 August and 24 December 2026. The company stated that the buyback is intended as part of its capital-allocation framework to support sustained growth and long-term corporate-value enhancement, complementing stable dividend payments with flexible and opportunistic shareholder returns in response to recent market conditions and stock-price trends.
